info.name: PavingFX
info.comment: Generates structured masonry, paving, tile and checker arrangements.

description.p: PavingFX is a source effect that takes no primary input. It partitions the pattern plane into rectangular elements separated by joints according to Layout (RUNNING, STACK, BASKET_WEAVE, HERRINGBONE or CHECKER), and evaluates each sample solely from its position in primitive units. Clipped, partial and full redraws therefore produce identical values.

Element dimensions are given by ElementWidth and ElementHeight, positioned by OriginX and OriginY, and rotated about the origin by Angle. Percentages in ElementWidth and OriginX refer to the width of the filter region, and percentages in ElementHeight and OriginY refer to its height. Percentages in JointWidth and BevelWidth refer to the normalised diagonal of the filter region (sqrt((width^2 + height^2) / 2)), so horizontal and vertical joints and bevels share the same thickness on non-square regions.

BASKET_WEAVE and HERRINGBONE require the resolved ElementWidth / ElementHeight ratio to lie within 1e-4 of an integer k >= 2. With the default ElementWidth = 25% and ElementHeight = 12.5%, this holds automatically on square filter regions and in BOUNDING_BOX primitive units.
Mode selects the generated field:

list.li: COLOUR: Draws elements using ElementColour (and AlternateColour for odd-parity cells in CHECKER) or an upstream ElementMap, separated by joints using JointColour or an upstream JointMap. Per-element perceptual OKLCH variation is controlled by HueVariation, ChromaVariation, LightVariation and Seed. Edges between elements and joints are analytically anti-aliased over one output pixel whenever JointWidth is positive.
HEIGHT: Produces a bevelled relief field rising from JointHeightValue in joints to ElementHeightValue plus seeded HeightVariation on element interiors, shaped across BevelWidth by BevelProfile.
MASK: Produces element coverage in [0, 1], with analytic edge anti-aliasing when JointWidth is positive.
ID: Produces a discrete seeded hash in [0, 1) per element, and 0 in joints.

description.p: In IMAGE OutputMode, scalar modes (HEIGHT, MASK and ID) clamp values to [0, 1] and draw opaque greyscale in the effect's colour space, or through ColourMap or Stops. Set OutputMode to HEIGHT to emit an unclamped floating-point scalar surface for numerical consumers such as LightingFX or CompositeFX. Mode = COLOUR cannot be combined with OutputMode = HEIGHT.

PeriodX and PeriodY wrap element keys so that seeded variation and ID output repeat without seams. Natural repeat vectors in pattern units are (W, 0) and (RowOffset * W, H) for RUNNING, (W, 0) and (0, H) for STACK, (2W, 0) and (0, 2H) for CHECKER, (2W, 0) and (0, 2W) for BASKET_WEAVE, and (2W, 0) and (0, 2W) (axis-aligned) for HERRINGBONE. A periodic pattern cannot be rotated (Angle must be a multiple of 360), a periodic RUNNING layout requires PeriodY * RowOffset to be an integer, and periodic CHECKER and BASKET_WEAVE layouts require even non-zero periods.
SVG documents can use the effect with the xvg:fePaving element. Refer to the SVG class for its attributes.

action.name: Draw
action.comment: Render the effect to the target bitmap.
action.prototype: ERR acDraw(*Object, DOUBLE X, DOUBLE Y, DOUBLE Width, DOUBLE Height)

input.param: The X position of the region to be drawn.
The Y position of the region to be drawn.
The width of the region to be drawn.
The height of the region to be drawn.

description.p: Draw fails with ERR::InvalidValue if Mode is COLOUR with OutputMode set to HEIGHT, if BASKET_WEAVE or HERRINGBONE is drawn with a resolved ElementWidth / ElementHeight ratio that is not within 1e-4 of an integer >= 2, if a periodic pattern is rotated, if a periodic RUNNING layout has a non-integer PeriodY * RowOffset, or if a periodic CHECKER or BASKET_WEAVE layout has an odd period. It fails with ERR::OutOfRange if pattern coordinates across the drawn area would exceed 2^52.

field.name: AlternateColour
field.comment: The colour of odd-parity cells in the CHECKER layout.

description.p: Stored in straight sRGB RGBA format with components clamped to [0, 1]. Defaults to #6b635a (opaque). Ignored by layouts other than CHECKER, and replaced by ElementMap when bound.

field.name: Angle
field.comment: Rotates the pattern clockwise about its origin, in degrees.

description.p: The rotation is applied about the point given by OriginX and OriginY. The value must be finite and defaults to 0. A periodic pattern cannot be rotated: if PeriodX or PeriodY is set, Angle must be a multiple of 360 or the effect will fail to draw.

field.name: BevelProfile
field.comment: Shapes the height transition across BevelWidth.

description.p: Selects the easing curve used to interpolate from JointHeightValue to the element interior height in HEIGHT mode. Defaults to LINEAR.

field.name: BevelWidth
field.comment: Width of the bevel transition inside each element edge, in pattern units.

description.p: The value must be finite and non-negative. A percentage refers to the normalised diagonal of the filter region. Defaults to 1%. A value of 0 produces a vertical step from JointHeightValue to the element height.

field.name: ChromaVariation
field.comment: Maximum seeded per-element OKLCH chroma offset.

description.p: Each element receives a deterministic offset in [-ChromaVariation, +ChromaVariation]. The value must lie in the range [0, 0.4] and defaults to 0.

field.name: ColourMap
field.comment: Draws scalar IMAGE output through a pre-defined colour ramp.

description.p: Applies when Mode is HEIGHT, MASK or ID and OutputMode is IMAGE. The clamped value selects a colour from the named colourmap, from 0 to 1. Setting a colourmap replaces custom Stops. Set an empty string to restore greyscale output. Unknown names fail with ERR::NotFound.

field.name: ElementColour
field.comment: The base colour of elements when ElementMap is not bound.

description.p: Stored in straight sRGB RGBA format with components clamped to [0, 1]. Defaults to #a89b8c (opaque).

field.name: ElementHeight
field.comment: The nominal element thickness, before rotation.

description.p: The value must be finite and greater than zero. A percentage refers to the height of the filter region. Defaults to 12.5%.

field.name: ElementHeightValue
field.comment: The nominal scalar height of element interiors in HEIGHT mode.

description.p: The value must be finite and defaults to 1.0. Each element's interior height is offset by up to HeightVariation.

field.name: ElementMap
field.comment: Optional upstream effect supplying a colour texture for elements.

description.p: Bind an earlier image-producing effect in the same filter to texture elements in COLOUR mode. FillMode selects whether the texture is mapped into each element's local coordinates (LOCAL) or sampled continuously in output coordinates (CONTINUOUS). Ignored when Mode is not COLOUR. Set to nullptr to restore solid ElementColour.

field.name: ElementWidth
field.comment: The nominal element length, before rotation.

description.p: The value must be finite and greater than zero. A percentage refers to the width of the filter region. Defaults to 25%.

field.name: FillMode
field.comment: Selects how ElementMap is mapped onto elements.

description.p: LOCAL, the default, maps the producer's subregion across each element in its own (u, v) coordinates and rotates with vertical elements in BASKET_WEAVE and HERRINGBONE. CONTINUOUS samples ElementMap directly at output coordinates.

field.name: HeightVariation
field.comment: Maximum seeded per-element height offset in HEIGHT mode.

description.p: Each element's interior height is offset by a deterministic value in [-HeightVariation, +HeightVariation]. The value must lie in the range [0, 100] and defaults to 0.

field.name: HueVariation
field.comment: Maximum seeded per-element OKLCH hue shift, in degrees.

description.p: Each element receives a deterministic hue offset in [-HueVariation, +HueVariation]. For achromatic base colours, a positive HueVariation assigns a uniformly distributed seeded hue when combined with ChromaVariation. The value must lie in the range [0, 180] and defaults to 0.

field.name: JointColour
field.comment: The base colour of joints when JointMap is not bound.

description.p: Stored in straight sRGB RGBA format with components clamped to [0, 1]. Defaults to #45413c (opaque).

field.name: JointHeightValue
field.comment: The scalar height of joints in HEIGHT mode.

description.p: The value must be finite and defaults to 0.0.

field.name: JointMap
field.comment: Optional upstream effect supplying a colour texture for joints.

description.p: Bind an earlier image-producing effect in the same filter to texture joints continuously in output coordinates when Mode is COLOUR. Ignored when Mode is not COLOUR. Set to nullptr to restore solid JointColour.

field.name: JointWidth
field.comment: Width of the gap between adjacent elements, in pattern units.

description.p: The value must be finite and non-negative. A percentage refers to the normalised diagonal of the filter region. Defaults to 1%. A value of 0 removes joints completely without mortar halos.

field.name: Layout
field.comment: Selects the tiling arrangement of elements.

description.p: Supported layouts are RUNNING (the default), STACK, BASKET_WEAVE, HERRINGBONE and CHECKER.

field.name: LightVariation
field.comment: Maximum seeded per-element OKLCH lightness offset.

description.p: Each element receives a deterministic lightness offset in [-LightVariation, +LightVariation], clamped to [0, 1]. The value must lie in the range [0, 1] and defaults to 0.

field.name: Mode
field.comment: Selects the content produced by the effect.

description.p: COLOUR, the default, draws coloured or textured elements and joints. HEIGHT emits the bevelled surface height field, MASK emits element coverage in [0, 1], and ID emits a discrete seeded hash in [0, 1) per element and 0 in joints. COLOUR cannot be combined with OutputMode HEIGHT.

field.name: OriginX
field.comment: The horizontal origin of the pattern, relative to the left edge of the filter region.

description.p: A percentage refers to the width of the filter region. The value must be finite and defaults to 0.

field.name: OriginY
field.comment: The vertical origin of the pattern, relative to the top edge of the filter region.

description.p: A percentage refers to the height of the filter region. The value must be finite and defaults to 0.

field.name: OutputMode
field.comment: Selects an image or a floating-point scalar result.

description.p: IMAGE, the default, writes RGBA8 pixels (coloured in COLOUR mode, or greyscale/colour-mapped for scalar modes). HEIGHT writes unclamped floating-point scalars for HEIGHT, MASK and ID modes, and is rejected at draw time when Mode is COLOUR. A HEIGHT effect cannot be the final step in a filter. NATIVE is unsupported.

field.name: PeriodX
field.comment: Repeats the pattern horizontally after this number of layout cells.

description.p: Periods count elements for RUNNING, STACK and CHECKER, square macro-cells of side ElementWidth for BASKET_WEAVE, and 2 * ElementWidth fundamental tiles for HERRINGBONE. The value must lie in [0, 1048576], and 0, the default, disables horizontal repetition.

field.name: PeriodY
field.comment: Repeats the pattern vertically after this number of layout cells.

description.p: The value must lie in [0, 1048576], and 0, the default, disables vertical repetition. See PeriodX.

field.name: ResampleMethod
field.comment: Selects interpolation for ElementMap in LOCAL fill mode.

description.p: Accepts NEIGHBOUR and BILINEAR (the default).

field.name: RowOffset
field.comment: Horizontal shift between consecutive courses in RUNNING layout, as a fraction of ElementWidth.

description.p: The value must be finite and defaults to 0.5 (half-brick running bond). Ignored by other layouts.

field.name: Seed
field.comment: Selects deterministic per-element appearance and height variation.

description.p: Any 64-bit integer is accepted, including 0, which is the default. The same seed always produces the same pattern.

field.name: Stops
field.comment: Draws scalar IMAGE output through a custom colour ramp.

description.p: Applies when Mode is HEIGHT, MASK or ID and OutputMode is IMAGE. At least two stops are required, or the setter fails with ERR::InvalidValue. Setting stops replaces any named ColourMap; set an empty array to clear the ramp and restore greyscale output.

field.name: XMLDef
field.comment: Describes the primitive using the FilterEffect.XMLDef format.

constants.comment: Output modes for ImageFX, TurbulenceFX, BlurFX, WaveFunctionFX and CellularFX.

Interlocking perpendicular elements in a zig-zag weave.
Horizontal courses shifted by RowOffset per row.
Regular axis-aligned grid of rectangular elements.
Sample ElementMap continuously in output coordinates across the pattern.
Map ElementMap across each element in its own local coordinates, rotating with the element.
Draw coloured elements and joints, with optional ElementMap, JointMap and OKLCH variation.
Output the bevelled surface height field.
Output a deterministic per-element hash in [0, 1), and 0 in joints.
Output element coverage (1 inside elements, 0 in joints).
Selects a resampling method automatically. The choice depends on the operation.
Uses a broad Bessel filter that can preserve detail during resampling, but is slower than the smaller-kernel methods.
Produces a similar result to BILINEAR at a slightly higher CPU cost and a marginally sharper after-effect.
Bilinear is a common algorithm that produces a reasonable quality image quickly.
Five times slower than BILINEAR, the final result will be less sharp than SINC.
Uses a Gaussian filter that softens the result, reducing aliasing at the cost of sharp edge detail.
Uses a Kaiser-windowed filter, giving smooth interpolation with low ringing and a cost close to BILINEAR.
This well known algorithm may serve as a point of comparison for evaluating the results of other methods. It shares characteristics with SINC and BLACKMAN.
Uses a Mitchell-Netravali filter, balancing sharpness and smoothness at a cost similar to BICUBIC.
Nearest neighbour is the fastest sampler at the cost of poor quality.
Uses a quadratic filter with a modest kernel, giving smoother results than BILINEAR with limited extra cost.
Five times slower than BILINEAR, the final result is of very good quality.

About twice as slow as BILINEAR, this method samples a 4x4 area and produces a considerably better result, and is a good choice for enlarging images without producing artifacts when contrasting colours are present.

struct.name: GradientStop
struct.comment: Describes a colour stop for the Gradient Stops field.
struct.field: An offset in the range of 0 - 1.0
